name: YouTube Automation - Publish Contract
notes: Import/build this contract in n8n after local paths and credentials are configured. Publishing engine remains the safety authority.

nodes.name: Run Production Orchestrator
nodes.purpose: Execute existing production pipeline only after explicit authorization

nodes.name: Check Production Report
nodes.purpose: Continue only when report status and all safety flags pass

nodes.name: Run QA Gate
nodes.purpose: Require ffprobe and full decode QA before publishing

nodes.name: Publish Long Video
nodes.purpose: Call publishing.engine with long-form manifest, metadata, and MP4

nodes.name: Publish Short Video
nodes.purpose: Call publishing.engine with Shorts manifest, metadata, and MP4

nodes.name: Notify and Archive Report
nodes.purpose: Send report through configured email/GitHub integration

failure_policy: Stop; retain artifacts and logs; never auto-retry an uncertain upload; regenerate only a failed production artifact after a new authorized run.
